artworks.title: King Ferdinand I
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in three-quarter view. He faces slightly left with his head turned in the same direction, showing a side profile. The man has distinctive facial features including a pronounced nose, thin lips, and deep-set eyes. His short, wavy, light-colored hair frames his face. He wears a large, round hat with decorations and a chain around his neck with a pendant. The man is dressed in an ornate, layered garment with a high collar and large sleeves. The background is dark and textured, and the image is designed in a monochromatic, engraved style. An inscription below the portrait suggests a historical figure.

artworks.title: King Ferdinand I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with short, wavy hair and prominent facial features, wearing an ornate hat and garment. The person faces slightly to the right in a side profile position. A chain around the neck suggests the presence of a medallion or pendant. The background has a textured, lined pattern, and there is an inscription in Latin at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Halberdier on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse. The person has a prominent nose, a defined chin, and a beard. They wear a flowing garment and a turban-style head covering. The person holds a long-barreled firearm. The setting is natural, with dense foliage and bushes. The horse has its head lowered, appearing to graze.

artworks.title: Riding Standard Bearer and Foot Soldier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man on a horse and a second man standing beside it. The scene features an elaborately dressed man mounted on a horse, holding a staff or lance, while another man, partially obscured and closer to the viewer, appears to be interacting with the horse. The composition shows intricate patterns on the clothing of both figures, especially on the mounted man's attire. The horse has a focused expression, and the background includes indications of a landscape with trees and elements of nature. The drawing conveys movement and interaction between the figures, capturing a moment suggestive of a conversation or transaction.

artworks.title: Sea-God on a Dolphin Riding to the Left
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a muscular figure holding a weapon over a large sea creature. The figure is depicted in a dynamic stance, while the sea creature has bulging eyes and sharp teeth. The drawing shows detailed cross-hatching and is made in a classical style.

artworks.title: Titus Gracchus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The image depicts a clash between centaurs and human figures. The composition features figures engaged in combat with various weapons and fighting stances. The centaurs are shown attacking and being attacked. The drawing uses fine lines and detailing to depict muscular forms and expressions of struggle. Actions extend across the panoramic format, creating a narrative of conflict.

artworks.title: Der Welt Lauf (Sleeping Justice)
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a surreal scene. It shows a sleeping figure with animals and a castle in the background. The artwork features a semi-nude figure reclining with a sleeping child, surrounded by animals including a fox carrying a sword and a lamb. In the background, there is a detailed depiction of a castle with turrets and walls, set against a wooded landscape. The words "DER WELT LAVF" are inscribed above the scene in the sky. The style resembles that of Albrecht Dürer, known for detailed engravings. The use of line work and shading creates a textured effect, enhancing the mystical atmosphere of the composition.

artworks.title: Foot Soldier in Front of a Tree
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical creature with human and animal features. The image depicts a figure with a heavily muscled and contorted body, resembling a combination of a human and a mythical creature. It stands in an unusual pose with its legs planted firmly on the ground, near some grass or foliage. Its upper body is robust with exaggerated bulges and muscles, detailed with elaborate linework. The creature holds a spear or staff in its right hand, and there seems to be a large sword tucked in its belt. The head and face are obscured by the position of the arms and shoulders. A tree trunk or branch extends upwards behind the creature, framing its upper body, with the date "1520" inscribed in the top right. The exaggerated proportions and intricate detailing reflect a touch of surrealism, distinctive of Northern Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated on the ground. He is supporting himself with one hand on a branch or staff while reaching out with the other hand. The man has a prominent nose, long mustache, and beard, with short hair. He is wearing detailed clothing with ornate trim, a belt, large beads around his neck, and leggings folded at the knee. In his right hand, he holds a book or plaque. Above him is a cherub with wings, muscles, and holding a cartouche labeled "1520," surrounded by clouds. The background shows a landscape with trees and a castle-like structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Michael Roting
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait, featuring his head and shoulders. The man has a straight posture, facing the viewer directly. He has distinct facial features such as a high forehead, prominent eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a full beard, and mustache. His curly medium-length hair is slightly receding at the sides. He is wearing an ornate garment with vertical striped patterns and a high collar. No jewelry or objects are visible on him. The background is plain, with the portrait set within a circular frame on a blank canvas with handwritten text beneath the circle.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman with Two Jugs
artworks.description: This print shows a person depicted from head to toe, standing upright and turning towards the left. One of their arms gestures out to the left, while the other is tucked under the edge of their garment. Their face is not visible, obscured by a hood that covers almost their entire head and neck, with a small opening that shows only their nose. The individual wears a long-sleeved, buttoned coat and a long skirt or robe. Two large jugs, one on each side, stand on the ground close to their feet, and a woven basket with grass or leaves is seen near the jug on the left. The background is plain, off-white paper. The artwork includes small handwritten numbers "1524" at the top left corner.

artworks.title: Naked Woman on an Armor (Prudentia?)
artworks.description: This print features a nude person seated on a surface that appears to be a breastplate. The person is sitting with their back towards us, turning slightly to the right, and they are looking over their shoulder towards us. Their facial features include a straight nose, large eyes, and curly hair combed back. The individual is holding a large urn-like object in their hands. Near the bottom-right corner, a helmet rests next to the breastplate. The background is filled with shaded diagonal lines.

artworks.title: Madonna with Skull
artworks.description: The image shows an adult woman facing left and looking down at a small child. The woman has braided hair, a calm expression, and a slight smile. She is wearing a blouse and is nursing the child. The child is reclined with closed eyes and curly hair. In the background, there is a landscape visible through a window with a castle or grand building, trees, and hills. A table near the woman and child holds an hourglass and a skull.

artworks.title: Madonna with Flower Vase
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a small child. The woman is seated and is holding the child with both hands, close to her chest. Her face is in profile, with a gentle gaze directed at the child. She has rounded facial features, and her head is adorned with an elaborate headpiece that includes multiple decorative elements. Her hair is mostly covered by this headpiece. The woman wears a gown with puffed sleeves, and a necklace can be seen around her neck. The child is shown from the waist up, and is turned slightly towards the woman, resting its head gently near her face. Both figures are surrounded by draped fabric that appears as a backdrop.

artworks.title: Lucretia Standing at a Column
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright next to a large pillar. The person is unclothed and holding a piece of cloth on their arm. They have long hair and detailed facial features, including closed lips. The setting includes architectural elements and a decorative stone structure. The image appears to be an engraving or etching with fine lines and hatching.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, facing forward with her head turned to the left. She has detailed facial features and a serene expression. Her hair is styled under a cap with horizontal bands. She wears an elaborate outfit with rich textures and patterns, including ruffled garment with puffed sleeves, fur trim, and a large brooch. She wears a chain necklace. In one hand, she holds a knife, and in the other, a severed head. The background has a textured surface with a ledge and sparse plant life.

artworks.title: Judith Seated on the Body of Holofernes
artworks.description: The image features a black and white engraving of a figure in a seated position holding a sword upright in their right hand. They are grasping the hair of a male head underfoot. The figure's facial features are finely detailed, showing pronounced cheekbones and wavy hair. The person appears nude with shading highlighting their musculature. Leafy vegetation surrounds the figure, and the background is minimal. The inscription "1525" is in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Genius on a Globe Floating in the Air
artworks.description: The image displays a cherubic figure with wings in the upper portion, set against clouds. The scene below features a pastoral setting. The engraving technique shows fine, linear brushstrokes for texture and shading. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow contrasts. In the distance are buildings with pitched roofs, likely a house or barn, surrounded by trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Cleopatra
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing beside a tree. She is positioned with her body facing slightly to the right, her head tilted down and to the right. Her facial features include a gently rounded face with closed eyes, and her hair styled back. The woman appears to be nude. She is holding a snake, coiled around her right arm with its head resting on her breast. The background features detailed foliage with leaves and grass surrounding the woman. The word "CLEOPATRA" is inscribed in the upper right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Emperor Charles V
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting an upper body portrait of a man viewed from a side profile. The man is looking to the right, with his head slightly tilted upward. He has a full beard and mustache, and a prominent nose. The man is wearing a hat that covers his curly hair, and elaborate robes or garments with intricate patterns, particularly on his shoulders and down the front. He is also wearing a necklace with a large pendant. The background features fine horizontal lines for texture, and below the portrait is an engraved Latin text.

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly person in profile view, facing left. The person appears slightly hunched, with deep-set facial lines, a large nose, and a protruding chin. They wear a furry hat covering their head and ears, along with a textured garment that could be fur or wool. The background features an etched circular vignette with crosshatch patterns. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: The Peasant in a Window
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body and head leaning out of a window. The person is hunched forward with their arms crossed on the window's edge. They have a shadowed complexion and are wearing a pointed cap or hood that covers their hair. The individual is dressed in a loose-fitting garment, likely a robe or cloak. Surroundings include the wooden frame of the window and an open shutter on the left side. The background inside the window is dark, contrasting with the lighter figure leaning out.
